package agent_policy

# LiteLLM on AMD SEV-SNP: pause, TLS fetch, credentials fetch and gateway.
# Exec/WriteStream denied so the host cannot steal Trustee-released material.
# ReadStream stays on so kubectl logs works.
#
# CreateContainerRequest is allowlist-enforced (2026-09-18, todo 4):
# only the pause container + the litellm gateway image may run in this guest,
# each with its expected UID (the fetch-certs init retired 2026-10-24 —
# eastwest-keys-strict fetches in-guest now). The same
# policy_data.containers list is
# extracted by the Trustee AS as agent_policy_claims (init-data is measured
# into the TD, so this allowlist is part of the quote). For that extraction
# (AS attestation-service/src/lib.rs extract_policy_data parses from the
# policy-data declaration to EOF as JSON) the policy_data block MUST be the
# last thing in this file and pure JSON after the brace — no trailing
# commas, no rules after it, and the declaration literal must not appear
# in any comment above it (find() would match the comment first). This
# mirrors genpolicy's own output format (rules first, data last).

import future.keywords.in

default CopyFileRequest := true
default CreateContainerRequest := false
default CreateSandboxRequest := true
default DestroySandboxRequest := true
default ExecProcessRequest := false
default GetOOMEventRequest := true
default GuestDetailsRequest := true
default OnlineCPUMemRequest := true
default PullImageRequest := true
default ReadStreamRequest := true
default RemoveContainerRequest := true
default RemoveStaleVirtiofsShareMountsRequest := true
default SignalProcessRequest := true
default StartContainerRequest := true
default StatsContainerRequest := true
default TtyWinResizeRequest := true
default UpdateEphemeralMountsRequest := true
default UpdateInterfaceRequest := true
default UpdateRoutesRequest := true
default WaitProcessRequest := true
default WriteStreamRequest := false

# Allow only allowlisted containers. The pause container (container-type
# "sandbox", no image-name annotation) and workload containers (image-name
# annotation) are checked against policy_data.containers below.
CreateContainerRequest if {
	i_oci := input.OCI

	# sandbox/pause container
	i_oci.Annotations["io.kubernetes.cri.container-type"] == "sandbox"
	some p in policy_data.containers
	p.OCI.Annotations["io.kubernetes.cri.container-type"] == "sandbox"
}

CreateContainerRequest if {
	i_oci := input.OCI
	i_uid := i_oci.Process.User.UID
	i_gid := i_oci.Process.User.GID

	i_image := i_oci.Annotations["io.kubernetes.cri.image-name"]

	some p in policy_data.containers
	p.OCI.Annotations["io.kubernetes.cri.image-name"] == i_image

	p_oci := p.OCI
	p_oci.Process.User.UID == i_uid
	p_oci.Process.User.GID == i_gid

	# pidns consistency: workload containers share the sandbox pid ns
	input.sandbox_pidns == p.sandbox_pidns
}

# Measured container allowlist — image names + UIDs (+ the pause container by
# container-type). Shape matches the AS extraction (agent_policy_claims):
#   containers[].OCI.Annotations."io.kubernetes.cri.image-name"
#   containers[].OCI.Process.User.UID
# UIDs (verified live via crictl on am-h200-28 2026-09-18): litellm-database
# runs as root (UID 0, image Dockerfile USER root); the pause container runs
# as 65535 (RKE2 mirrored-pause, "nobody"). sandbox_pidns is FALSE for every
# container here — runtime-rs is_pid_namespace_enabled() returns true only
# when the PID namespace entry has a path set, and these pods share no PID ns
# (verified live: pid ns path=None on pause + both workloads). Image references
# must match OCI exactly: tag@digest is preserved by this runtime + containerd
# path in io.kubernetes.cri.image-name (verified in host kata journal 2026-11-10).
# Only the CURRENT image is listed (stale tags pruned 2026-10-24) — the
# allowlist is part of the measured initdata, and a new image tag always
# rebuilds initdata anyway. MUST stay last in this file (see header comment).
policy_data := {
	"containers": [
		{
			"OCI": {
				"Annotations": {
					"io.kubernetes.cri.container-type": "sandbox"
				},
				"Process": {"User": {"UID": 65535, "GID": 65535}}
			},
			"sandbox_pidns": false
		},
		{
			"OCI": {
				"Annotations": {
					"io.kubernetes.cri.image-name": "docker.io/curlimages/curl:8.11.1@sha256:c1fe1679c34d9784c1b0d1e5f62ac0a79fca01fb6377cdd33e90473c6f9f9a69"
				},
				"Process": {"User": {"UID": 100, "GID": 101, "AdditionalGids": [101]}}
			},
			"sandbox_pidns": false
		},
		{
			"OCI": {
				"Annotations": {
					"io.kubernetes.cri.image-name": "ghcr.io/kubetee-ai/litellm-database:1.110.2-kubetee.6@sha256:14b7601d7468a47744c19abd4f5ecccbde3a65e668881f054f6cb993ddafc8da"
				},
				"Process": {"User": {"UID": 0, "GID": 0, "AdditionalGids": [0]}}
			},
			"sandbox_pidns": false
		}
	]
}
